versions.short: The bill would extend and update a federal program that improves forecasts of how much water will be available from snowpack, which matters for water management and reservoir operations. It would direct the program to focus on more accurate and timely snow measurement and water supply forecasting, including newer technologies such as imaging spectroscopy, machine learning, and snowpack and hydrologic modeling. It would also expand the program to cover water supply forecasting for multiple water users, river basins, and states, and to build the capacity of partners to use the new tools. The bill would require reports on which basins use the technologies, which methods work best, and how new forecasts compare with existing federal benchmarks. Funding would be set at $3,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031.
